description: Foundation training prompts and session pack for Planly

prompts.statement: Implement first_repeat(values) which returns the value whose second occurrence has the smallest index in the input list. If no value appears more than once, return None.
constraints: Expected O(n) time and O(n) auxiliary space

examples.explanation: 4's second occurrence is at index 2, while 2's second occurrence is at index 3.

clarificationBranches.question: Can values contain negative integers or zeros?
clarificationBranches.answer: Yes, values may contain arbitrary positive or negative integers, and zero.

clarificationBranches.question: What should be returned for an empty list or single-element list?

followups.question: Instead of returning just the value, return a tuple (first_index, second_index) of the earliest repeating element, or None if none.
followups.criterion: Tracks initial index in hash map alongside presence, returns tuple of indices correctly.

privateReference.approach: Maintain a hash set of observed numbers while scanning left to right. The first number already in the set is the answer.
checks: Handles large lists without timing out

packs.title: Foundation Drill: Core Invariants
packs.instructions: Implement the requested function within 30 minutes. Be mindful of hash lookups, boundary indices, and time complexity.
